screens.title: BoneScope Research Studio - Mobile Companion Polished

notes: The Stitch desktop and mobile layouts have been adapted into the existing vanilla HTML/CSS/JavaScript chatbot frontend. Local implementation uses system fonts and inline SVG, without the prototype CDN dependencies.
Chatbot copy is educational and retrieval-oriented. Do not present prototype placeholder text as medical advice or verified clinical content.

implementation.validation: 176 passed and 132 subtests passed across api_tests, rag/tests, tests, and ui_tests; node --check rag/demo_web/app.js passed; rag.audit, rag.replay_reports (16/16), and tools.verify_stage11_registers (24/24) passed.
implementation.researchStudioNote: Pro Obsidian & Bioluminescent Cyan theme (graphite.css), asymmetric welcome, three-step image-case flow with 6 BTXRD sample chips and SHA-256 auto-fill, clipboard/drag-drop image attachment, source-first chat, reduced-motion support; screenshots are local UI previews, not model evaluation.
